name: Azariah
overview: Azariah was a male member of the tribe of Ephraim known as the son of Johanan. He is noted in Scripture for aiding the defeated people of Judah, demonstrating a significant role in intertribal support during a time of conflict. There are no additional personal notes recorded about him.
namesAndTitles: The name Azariah means 'YHWH has helped,' reflecting a recognition of divine assistance. This proper name, referenced in 2 Chronicles 28:12, underscores a reliance on God's help rather than human strength.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture explicitly records that Azariah was the son of Johanan, as stated in 2 Chronicles 28:12. Beyond this paternal relationship, no other family connections are documented in the biblical text concerning Azariah.
scriptureSignificance: Azariah's significance lies in his faithful action to assist the Judaites after their defeat, highlighting a spirit of cooperation and aid among the tribes of Israel. Though not extensively detailed, his role as a helper during a time of distress reflects God's provision through His people. The meaning of his name aligns with this theme of divine help, emphasizing reliance on God in challenging circumstances.
